description: Renovate is not run from this repository. The fleet runner in shakenfist/development (.github/workflows/renovate-fleet.yml) runs it over every managed repository, and the policy comes from the preset extended here, renovate-fleet.json in that repository: the schedule, automerge policy, release-age delay and rollbacks, the pre-commit manager that keeps the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml current, the shellcheck-py tag versioning those hooks need, digest pinning of third-party actions, and the dashboard, assignee and git author. None of those belong at the top level here: a local value replaces the preset's outright, and the consistency audit reports it. What this repository needs differently goes in a packageRules entry scoped to what it is about, as the two below are. docs/development.md says how to run Renovate by hand.

packageRules.description: The Entra publishing path reads two files inside vsce that no public API covers, so a bump can break releases silently. This note reaches the reviewer of the bump, which the script headers do not: a bump touches package.json, not tools/.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Before merging, re-read two files in the new version. `out/auth.js`: if `WorkloadIdentityCredential` has joined the `ChainedTokenCredential`, `tools/marketplace-token.mjs` can be deleted in favour of `vsce publish --azure-credential`. `out/publish.js`: if `getPAT()` no longer routes `-p`/`VSCE_PAT` and `--azure-credential` into the same value, publishing is broken and there will be no other signal until a release is attempted. Also confirm `out/auth.js` still requests the scope `499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798/.default`, which `tools/marketplace-token.mjs` holds a copy of. See that file and RELEASE-SETUP.md.

customManagers.description: The node:22 image that tools/build-vsix.sh and tools/publish-marketplace.sh run in is pinned by digest in a shell script, which none of the stock managers read. Both source the pin from tools/container-image.sh, so there is one line here to keep current rather than two that could drift. Without this the pin ages until a release fails on a digest upstream has garbage-collected, which RELEASE-SETUP.md already lists as a troubleshooting case.
